newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola falls on commission and hedge selling.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola falls on commission and hedge selling.

text.p: WCE canola ended down on commercial and hedge selling, traders said.

"Hedges picked up, crushers bought the July, commercials bought on Chicago's firmness and canola's weakness. UGG, Cargill traded both ways. Commission houses took profits," a trader said. March futures crush profit margin rose to -22.87 from -25.32 Wednesday on CBOT soy oil, meal. Mar-May spread $0.50, Mar-July $0.40, July-Nov $36.50, May-Nov $37. Volume was 8,854 lots, or 177,080 tonnes, and 1,365 hedge lots.
March canola fell $2.30 to $408.40 and May slipped $1.50 to $408. May flax fell $0.50 to $350 on hedges. Mar-May $1.50.
February western barley rose $0.20 to $136.20 on short covering against commercial long liquidation and March climbed $0.20 to $135.30. Mar-May spread at even money, Feb-Mar $0.50.
March feed wheat lost $0.60 to $168.90 on commercial liquidation met by Cargill buying, traders said, and UGG sold July down $0.80 to $161.20. Mar-May spread at $3.50.
UGG bought February feed peas up US$1 to US$207, traders said.
Commission houses bid the oats up but none traded.
(Values in Canadian dollars/tonne except oats and peas.)
